'''Resurrect Greater Ghost''' is a [[resurrection spells|resurrection spell]] within the [[Arceuus spellbook]] that requires level 76 [[Magic]] and the completion of [[A Kingdom Divided]] to be cast. In addition to the required runes, casting this spell requires six [[prayer points]] and having the [[Book of the Dead]] equipped or in the player's inventory.

The spell will summon a [[greater ghostly thrall]], which has an [[attack speed]] of 4 (attacking every 2.4 seconds) and attacks using [[Magic]] (with a max hit of 3), ignoring any accuracy checks in the process. They will attack the same target that the player is attacking, and cannot be damaged. However, they '''cannot''' attack other players. Damage dealt by the thrall counts as damage dealt by the player that summoned it.

Thralls will remain for a set amount of time (<math>0.6 * CurrentMagicLevel</math> seconds), but players can cast resurrection spells again after 10 seconds, albeit the existing thrall will disappear if players do so.

Summoned [[thrall]]s last twice as long as normal after claiming the [[Master Combat Achievements]] rewards.

The '''trinket of undead''' is an item in [[Deadman Mode]] that allows players to summon a special [[thrall]] of the player's choice, being either [[TzRek-Zuk]], the [[Kalphite Princess#Flying|Kalphite Princess]], or [[Wisp]]. These thralls function the same as greater thralls, functioning as a melee, ranged, or magic thrall respectively. Though the trinket has no requirements to use, it does have a 10 second cooldown.

Being identical to regular greater thralls, the trinket's thralls always deal [[successful hit]]s, with the damage roll ranging from 0-3. The damage roll can be increased to 0-15 with the [[sigil of the augmented thrall]].

It can be acquired as a drop from monsters found during [[breach]]es, as well as from looting the [[Deadman's chest (scenery)|Deadman's chest]].
